livingRoom.name: The "Living" Room
livingRoom.description: You perceive a room of red pulsating walls and a relentless odor, the realization hits you the same time it's eyes turn to look at you

kitchen.name: The Kitchen
kitchen.description: You find yourself in a kitchen. Why? You hungry or something? Not like we have anything...

observatory.name: The Observatory
observatory.description: There's a man here, he seems to be staring into a box with a microscope. "come lad! You must see this!" Instead you decided to look up, there's a giant eyeball staring down at you

flesh-cube.name: Flesh Cube
flesh-cube.description: It's a cube made of flesh. "It's rude to stare you know?"

poop.name: Something Brown and Sticky
poop.description: Look I don't know man you were the one who picked it up

knife.name: Knife
knife.description: Holding this, you are filled with a feeling of DETERMINATION

tupperware.name: Tupperware Bowl... Thing
tupperware.description: No matter how hard you wash it you can still see and smell hints of spahgetti on it

crumpled-paper.name: Crumpled Paper
crumpled-paper.description: The text is too small to read
